1074-4613-7014.easyPrerequisites:
King Macar doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
North Pole Patrol is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
1074-4613-7014.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1074-4613-7014.description:
Activate King Macar using North Pole Patrol's ability by tapping it, untapping another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the other creature using North Pole Patrol's ability by tapping it, untapping King Macar
King Macar triggers, allowing you to exile a creature and create a Gold token if you do.
Repeat.

1284-3800-4687.notablePrerequisites: Iceberg has at least four counters on it.
1284-3800-4687.description:
Activate Viridian Longbow by tapping Gilder Bairn, producing its effect.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Iceberg.
Activate Iceberg as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least three mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Iceberg, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

1563-2457-4742-7824.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

1987-4823-6259.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-4823-6259.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Timeless Witness.
When Timeless Witness enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-4823-6259.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

1263-4871-4976-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Open the Graves trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3525-3711-6006.description:
Activate Moonfolk Puzzlemaker by tapping it, adding {U}.
Moonfolk Puzzlemaker triggers, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Moonfolk Puzzlemaker.
Repeat.

4616-5220-6505-6900.description:
Activate Spore Frog by sacrificing it.
When Spore Frog dies, Mortuary and Moldervine Reclamation trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Spore Frog from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and draw a card.
Resolve the Spore Frog ability.
Cast Spore Frog from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

550-1618-2440-3992.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Young Pyromancer
550-1618-2440-3992.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Cyclical Evolution.
Cyclical Evolution triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Young Pyromancer triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Cyclical Evolution.
Repeat.
550-1618-2440-3992.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Young Pyromancer. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

1879-3094-4659-5390-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
1879-3094-4659-5390-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {2} due to Forensic Gadgeteer and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed, targeting Lithoform Engine.
Resolve the copy of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine from your graveyard to the battlefield as a 3/3 Robot artifact creature.
Repeat from step 2.

4907-6556-6797-6989.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with power 4 or greater.
4907-6556-6797-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Temur Battlecrier. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

628-2511-7195.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Chaos Spewer.
When Chaos Spewer dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Chaos Spewer enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability
Repeat.

142-6320.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Saheeli, Radiant Collector triggers, causing you to pay {E}{E}{E} to create a token copy of Saheeli Rai that is a 5/5 artifact creature with haste in addition to its other types.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate the token Saheeli Rai's second ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, creating a token copy of it with haste.
Repeat step 3.

413-2173-3652-5220.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Ornithopter
When Ornithopter dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Ornithopter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Cast Ornithopter from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
When Ornithopter enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

2257-4522-5346-6891.easyPrerequisites: A permanent you control has a removable quest counter on it.
2257-4522-5346-6891.description:
Activate Duchess by paying {1} and removing a quest counter from a permanent you control, creating a Junk token.
When the Junk enters, Reckless Fireweaver triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Quest for Pure Flame triggers, putting a quest counter on it.
Activate the Junk by tapping and sacrificing it.
Crime Novelist triggers, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Junk's ability, exiling the top card of your library with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Repeat.

1894-2173-5220-6273.description:
Activate Bile Urchin by sacrificing it.
When Bile Urchin dies, Mortuary and Embalmed Ascendant trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Bile Urchin from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bile Urchin ability.
Cast Bile Urchin from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

3693-4565-4613-6843.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Ozolith, the Shattered Spire.
Activate Anti-Venom using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

341-586-5258-5618-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a type chosen that matches the creature castable for two colorless mana

2034-5113-5220--53.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature that can be cast using {C}{C}, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
2034-5113-5220--53.notes: If the creature can be cast using {C} or less, the combo nets infinite colorless mana.

2525-4681-5147.description:
Cast Body Double by paying {4}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
When Body Double enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Body Double.
Resolve the Body Double trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Body Double.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Body Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
Repeat from step 2.

92-2935-3392.description:
Activate Vizkopa Guildmage's second ability by paying {1}{W}{B}, causing each opponent to lose life whenever you gain life this turn.
Activate Ethereal Champion by paying 1 life.
Repeat step 2 until you have 1 life.
Activate Children of Korils by sacrificing it, causing you to gain life equal to the amount of life you've lost this turn.
Vizkopa Guildmage triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the amount of life you gained.

631-3967-6249--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
631-3967-6249--5.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Grim Haruspex trigger.
Resolve the Grim Haruspex trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

915-4306-5856.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three devotion to any color.
You control a Food.
915-4306-5856.description:
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate a Food using Synod Artificer's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping the Food and Nyx Lotus.
Repeat.

957-2061-2493.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Time Stretch each other turn.
957-2061-2493.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Archaeomancer.
When the Archaeomancer token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

1170-1328-2105-4885.notablePrerequisites:
You have an instant card exiled by Spellbinder's imprint ability that has legal targets, if needed.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Spellbinder attached to any creature except Combat Celebrant that does not have summoning sickness.
1170-1328-2105-4885.description:
Declare Combat Celebrant and the creature with Spellbinder attached as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Spellbinder attached.
Spellbinder triggers, causing you to copy a card exiled with it, and cast the copy without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Resolve the spell cast in step 4.
Repeat each combat phase.

3129-4518-5554.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Treasure or Gold token.
3129-4518-5554.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {1}{W}.
Oltec Matterweaver triggers, creating two token copies of any Treasure or Gold token you control.
When Kor Skyfisher enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, or two Golds by sacrificing them, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.

1920-2060-4029-4222-5328.notablePrerequisites: Freed from the Real attached to Attentive Sunscribe.
1920-2060-4029-4222-5328.description:
Activate Freed from the Real's first ability by paying {U}, tapping Attentive Sunscribe.
Attentive Sunscribe triggers, causing you to scry 1.
Arwen Undómiel triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Attentive Sunscribe.
Repeat.

224-539-2459-5094-5196.notablePrerequisites: Murasa Rootgrazer does not have summoning sickness.
224-539-2459-5094-5196.description:
Activate Murasa Rootgrazer's second ability by tapping it, returning Rograkh to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
When Rograkh enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Murasa Rootgrazer.
Repeat.

717-2035-4067.notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {B}.
717-2035-4067.description:
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding Gollum.
Bone Miser's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Mind over Matter ability, untapping a mana-producing permanent.
Activate the permanent by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Activate Gollum by paying {B} and sacrificing the Zombie, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1651-4330-4772.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has fought this turn.
1651-4330-4772.description:
Activate Boxing Ring by tapping it, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Treasures, untapping Boxing Ring.
Repeat.

2493-3603-4050-5316.description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying {W}, targeting Archaeomancer.
Tura Kennerüd triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Cloudshift, blinking Archaeomancer.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Cloudshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Soldier, adding {W}.
Repeat.

643-2102-3690.description:
Cast Sylvan Awakening by paying {2}{G}, causing all lands you control to become 2/2 Elemntal creatures with haste until end of turn.
Activate Griffin Canyon's second ability by tapping it, untapping itself and giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat step 2.

1651-1737-2119-3698.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {0} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Seat of the Synod.
The Seat of the Synod token enters, triggering Grinding Station, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Seat of the Synod token and Grinding Station, untapping Prototype Portal.
Repeat.
